headline: Executive order changes an earlier 2017 order that brought back the National Space Council.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13803, which revived the National Space Council, a White House group that advises the President on space policy. The title does not say what specific changes were made. No summary was provided, so the details of the changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the National Space Council
who_it_affects.how: The rules for how the council is set up or run were changed in some way not described in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 13, 2020; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
